title: Suno Intelligence semantic composition model
purpose: A machine-readable vocabulary for agents to select, combine, critique, and learn from musical elements without storing or copying repertoire, melodies, recordings, or artist identities.

tradition.use: bounded contextual role logic only; never claim representation or authenticity

grammar.use: repeatable behavior across time, density, call/response, layer entry, or release

rhythm.use: pulse, subdivision, accent, silence, and propulsion role

bass.use: low-frequency anchor, motion, pressure, and harmonic relationship

harmony.use: tonal center, color, cadence pressure, and ambiguity

melody.use: contour, range, recurrence, handoff, and release

instrument.use: acoustic or synthetic source role, articulation, register, and pairing

sound_source.use: original material behavior, not a named preset

voice.use: original cast role, register, texture, diction, and interaction; never impersonation

lyric.use: writing behavior, image logic, vocal space, and failure prevention

production.use: spatial, textural, dynamic, and mix behavior

relationship.use: explicit compatible, contrast, bridge, conflict, or counterweight evidence

world.use: original coherent destination assembled from other records

suno_observation.use: versioned observation of prompt behavior or a model artifact; not assumed fact

voiceCasting.principle: A cast is a set of original roles, not a celebrity or an instruction to imitate one.
cast_rules: Choose one lead role unless the form deliberately transfers leadership.
Supporting voices must answer, shadow, widen, or interrupt; they may not merely double the lead.
Assign a register separation or material contrast between simultaneous voices.
Do not name living or historical singers as target voices.

lyricAndArtifactControls.artifact_protocol: If the generation produces unwanted wop-wop, gibberish, stray ad-libs, or unstable vocal artifacts, log the exact prompt, mode, lyric condition, timecode, and artifact label in a suno_observation. The next brief must specify the correction as an explicit avoid condition; it is not a musical element to normalize.

sequence: select a grammar that determines movement
add one contrast or bridge material
reject_when: two elements fight for the same structural role without a handoff
a tradition is used as a label instead of bounded role logic
a voice brief asks for an identifiable singer
the arrangement has no state change
the lyric behavior leaves no intelligible vocal space

sunoPromptEvidence.rule: Treat model behavior as provisional until a repeatable observation has been recorded. Never convert folklore about prompting into a library fact.
